'''2001 Ben Con tournament (8 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local (convention) held at Ben Con, Holiday Inn, Parker, Colorado on 8 June 2001. [[Jason Keen]] won it. It is known from Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2449">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-13-ben-con-denver-co-6-8-01-brave-new-worldd2449/ ben-con-denver-co-6-8-01-brave-new-world], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 13 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-13-ben-con-denver-co-6-8-01-brave-new-worldd2449/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Ben Con, Holiday Inn, Parker, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Keen]]
